notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that caused ships to continually fall into a hole on Planet 11's runway.
- Adjusted the price of Engine 4, which was too cheap.

notes.title: AI Improvements and Pre-Race Position Display
notes.content:
- Improved the AI of competitors. They now respond better to the use of special items. Specific behavior profiles have also been created: aggressive racers prefer shooting, defensive ones jump more to dodge bullets, and balanced ones stay in between.
- Player positions are now displayed before the race starts, not only after the race begins.

notes.title: Improvements and New Features
notes.content:
Update 1.1 – Improvements and New Features

- Settings Added: Configuration option to change screen resolution.
- Enhanced Compatibility: Improved controller support for split-screen cooperative mode with 2 players.

- Special Items Changes:
The 4 special items previously sold and activated by the "use special item" button now grant a bonus at the start of the race.
The "use special item" button is now dedicated solely to activating bonus items.

- Shop Update: The Explosive Mine has been removed from the shop's weapon list, replaced by the Blaster.

- New in All Races:
A Bonus Item Coin has been added to every race. Collecting this coin rewards the player with one of the following random items:

    1. Homing Missile
    2. Repair / Heal
    3. Invincibility
    4. Mini Dash
    5. Explosive Mine
    6. Slippery Banana
    7. Quintuple Shot

notes.title: Improvements
notes.content: - Player number 2's controller now responds without delay in the shopping menu

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: Fixed a bug where a super jump in the triple mirrors on planet Theta was not counting as a lap completed

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: - Fixed a bug that caused the ship to be propelled into mirrors even when it was jumping

notes.title: Improvements
notes.content:
- The main menu has been redesigned
- The health recovery item and nitros can be picked up even while your ship is jumping
- Fixed a bug on player 2's gamepad

notes.title: Improvements
notes.content:
- It is now possible to sell your equipment
- An explanatory prompt has been added to the in-game store
- On planet 5, the reversing mirrors have been replaced by side mirrors and a gap between them has been added to make things easier.

notes.title: Game Update Improvements
notes.content:
- When your ship was destroyed, you always ended up in last place. Now, if any other ship is destroyed before you, you will be ahead of it.
- The shots used to collide with the thrusters, but now they no longer do.
- The enemy shots weren’t colliding with the walls, but now they are.

notes.title: bug Fix
notes.content: Fixed a bug in the save menu.

notes.title: Improvements
notes.content:
- Mapping in settings is now saved automatically
- Pause Menu now provides information about game modes and controls
- Planet Omega has been made easier once again

notes.title: Balancing
notes.content:
- Reduced difficulty of planet Omega
- Reduced volume of start signal

notes.title: Translation improvements
notes.content:
- Some improvements have been made to translations
- The pause screen that was displayed when the game was not in focus will now only appear during races and no longer in the purchase or main menus

notes.title: Balancing
notes.content:
Removed some obstacles on planet 17
Added ship repair points on planet 17

notes.title: Balancing
notes.content:
- When moving to the next planet, players recover their health.
- Some opponents who bought the second engine on planets 14 and 15 now only buy it on planet 16
